hand_arithmetic: 1.875 uA = 1.875e-6 A = 1.875e9 fA (multiply by 1e15 to go from A to fA)
I111 nominal = 8 x 1.875e-6 A = 1.5e-5 A = 15.000 uA, which is the shared reference itself
unit deviation limit = 0.25 x Iunit_ref; with Iunit_ref = I111/8 = 15 uA / 8 = 1.875 uA that is 0.46875 uA
settle band = +/- 5% of the target of the code under test, hold at least 10 ns
shutoff leakage = max(abs(I_sink)) over the last 100 ns of each declared tail window <= 0.15 uA
1 TON = 1000 ns, so the nominal 120 ns and 200 ns platforms are 0.12 and 0.20 TON

launch_budget.counts: every launch counts, including -h, failures, aborts, crashes and debug; REQUESTED occupies the budget before the run and recovery never refunds it; preflight and DUT are counted separately

probe.sign_rule: I_sink = Ip_branch with no negation and no abs(); Q = integral of I_sink over the declared window, positive charge accumulating during the conducting window; the off-window tail is integrated as its own negative area and never cancels against it to claim a shut branch; declared before any run, not chosen after a sign
probe.tail_sign: a shutoff tail may be positive or negative; it is never pre-assumed to be a negative area

repairs_r1.repair: value = int(code, 2); bit(k) = (value >> k) & 1; volts = bit * logic_high_V, used by the DC decks and the transient PWL alike, and read back from the delivered decks by an independent parser rather than from the generator

repairs_r1.repair: a code change is old value at t-1 and new value at t+1 inside the pure-off window; windows are five named kinds (see rules.window_kinds) with start strictly less than stop; the leakage window must lie wholly inside the pure-off window or the configuration is refused; the 50 % edges are interpolated from the delivered PWL and must equal the table

charge_error.dc_cases: not_applicable: a DC sweep has no time-domain QLSB
forbidden_denominators: T50 of the window under test
the current code nominal x T50
charge_error.idc_substitution_forbidden: a geometry-ratio estimate is never used as IDC(k)
charge_error.lsb_definition: QLSB = Iunit_nominal x Ttick, with Ttick the case's own reference tick from reference_tick_s_by_case; the full-enable window T50 enters only the expected charge, never the denominator
charge_error.reference_tick_note: this mapping exists to remove the ambiguity the review found; it is a measurement reference unit for the POC, it does not mean TCON or display timing is implemented, and it grants no native authority. Partners share one tick, and an unknown or missing case is a named refusal, never a fallback to the window length
reported: Qexpected_dc = IDC(k) x T50 or NOT_RUN
reference_tick_s, qlsb_C, t50_s and where the tick came from

two_times_must_not_be_confused.T50: fall50 - rise50 of this window, used for Qexpected = I x T50
two_times_must_not_be_confused.Ttick: the per-case reference tick below, used for QLSB only

convergence.also_report: absolute dQ in coulombs (and fC), per window
convergence.note: CONVERGED without an absolute difference is refused as an answer, and two sides that both lack every context field are not "equal" -- they are missing context, which is REFUSED_MISSING_CONTEXT. R2 adds reference_tick_s to that list and requires it to equal the tick the function divides by, because two sides that both carry the window length as their reference would otherwise hide the unit drift together

deck_syntax.dc_form: dc_case dc dev=Vclamp param=dc start=0.6 stop=1.5 step=0.05
deck_syntax.note: these are the spellings this project has already run on the build; adopting them is not a native syntax verdict. NATIVE_NETLIST_SYNTAX stays NOT_VERIFIED until an authorised launch reads the deck.
deck_syntax.pwl_form: Vname (node 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[t1 v1 t2 v2 ...]
deck_syntax.tran_form: tran_case tran stop=<this case absolute ns> maxstep=<this case ns>

eight_level_ratio.iunit_ref_definition: Iunit_ref = I111 / 8 from the SAME DC conditions
eight_level_ratio.normalisation_rule: a scaled-down array must not be rescued by normalisation: the eight-level ratio pass does not substitute the 15 uA absolute pass

enable_edges.note: the first DATA_EN ramp of TR-LONG runs 1000 ns -> 1100 ns with its 50 % point at 1050 ns; writing a (1000, 0) hold point and then ramping to (1050, high) would put the crossing at 1025 ns while the table says 1000 ns, which is the defect this rule exists to refuse

launch_budget.counts: every launch counts, including -h, failures, aborts, crashes and debug; REQUESTED occupies the budget before the run and recovery never refunds it; preflight and DUT are counted separately

process_corner.model_family: SMIC18 models already used by the accepted POC
process_corner.note: no model card was opened this round; the exact local model identity is a check for the approved native stage. The declared 27 C is only a condition once every deck writes it as a statement: `simopt options temp=27` is the instantiation form the accepted DATA-7B bench uses, and a contract line is not a deck condition

sampling.finite_check: every time and current must be finite; NaN or infinity is a named refusal
sampling.grid_forcing: forbidden: adaptive native samples are not snapped to a ps grid
sampling.monotonic_time: strictly increasing; equal or regressed time is a named refusal

settling.deadline: the end of the declared window
settling.edge_detection: adjacent samples plus linear interpolation at 50% of the enable level; no real edge is a named refusal, never a fallback to the window end
settling.reference: the target current of the code under test

shutoff_leakage.cancellation_rule: a tail whose positive and negative parts nearly cancel is NOT zero leakage; report Q, Qpos and the magnitude of Qneg separately

supplies.note: AGENTS.md pit 19: a vss that is not tied to a real 0 V source makes every NMOS path disappear and the board reads as if only PMOS worked

window_kind_naming.why_these_names: the emission and off_tail kinds keep the two words the independent review instrument selects on, and schedule.csv keeps off_window_ns as the pair-spelled copy of pure_off_start_ns/pure_off_stop_ns, so the reviewer can read the repaired bytes with its own unchanged tool; the five windows are still named apart, and both dd1_d7c_b_prep_schedule.validate and dd1_d7c_b_prep_r1_deck_read refuse the day the pair spelling and the two columns disagree

emission.use: the charge of the whole enable window, the number convergence compares

leak_last100.use: the magnitude test max(abs(I_sink)) against the shutoff limit, and nothing else

off_tail.bounds: this fall50 -> next rise_start, or the declared stop for the last platform
off_tail.use: signed tail Q, never folded into the emission charge

pure_off.use: the only region a code change or a leakage measurement may live in

schedule.pam_bit_rule: value = int(code, 2); pam0 = bit 0 (weight 1), pam1 = bit 1 (weight 2), pam2 = bit 2 (weight 4); level = bit x 1.8 V
schedule.shift_rule: platform, 50% edges, ramp endpoints, code change, integration window, tail, pure-off, leakage sub-window and stop all shift by the same 1050 ns; the pure-off preparation ends at 1000 ns and the first ramp starts there, so no hold point sits inside a ramp

single_source: scripts/dd1_d7c_b_prep_contract.py emits this file; decks, schedule and reports render from it and from nothing else

units.display_precision_rule: a ns column with four decimals resolves at 0.1 ps, and every tolerance names its LSB and its quantisation term
